{{Quote|No bounty hunters allowed here, Solo!|The individual, to [[Han Solo]]|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
An [[Unidentified fin-headed species|alien]] '''individual''' was present aboard the [[Junkfort Station/Legends|Junkfort Station]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="PowerGem" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Date">"[[The Power Gem]]" is set after the events of {{Film|IV}} and before the [[Evacuation of Yavin 4]], and it therefore takes place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> This station banned [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], but when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] visited the station while searching for a [[power gem]], this individual and their [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified Human Junkfort Station cantina patron|companion]] decided to try and capture Solo and claim his [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Solo, however, realized their plan and avoided their initial [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot. Engaging in a brawl with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], the individual was about to overpower him when Solo's [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] companion [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] joined the fight and overpowered the assailants.<ref name="PowerGem" />
